evidence: Has IPC label and modifies IPC socket listening in src/ipc/listen.cpp, interfaces in src/interfaces/ipc.h, and IPC tests.
rationale: Enforces per-listener connection limits and reserves IPC file descriptors during node initialization to prevent file descriptor exhaustion and node instability under heavy IPC socket usage (PR description: 'risking file descriptor exhaustion and node instability under heavy IPC socket usage'). Member ryanofsky notes this 'fixes a gap in descriptor accounting, and adds a helpful connection limiting feature' across different IPC consumers.
